newsitem.title: USA: Court rules Los Angeles County underpaid welfare.
newsitem.headline: Court rules Los Angeles County underpaid welfare.

text.p: California's Supreme Court has refused to overturn a lower court ruling that directed Los Angeles County to pay $136 million in retroactive welfare benefits, according to a published report on Thursday.

The ruling strengthened the hand of lawyers negotiating with the county on behalf of more than 60,000 general relief welfare recipients, whose monthly grants were cut by $73 from 1993 to 1995, the Los Angeles Times reported.
Los Angeles County officials said the Supreme Court's decision had been expected. Last month, the Board of Supervisors approved cuts to help the county pay for the retroactive benefits.
